questions.solution:
$(x - 7)^{2} + \left(\sqrt{9 - (x - 4)^{2}} - 4\right)^{2}$
Square of distance between

Minimum distance $= PC - r = 5 - 3 = 2$
Ans 4

questions.stem: Let $S = \left\{2, 2^{2}, 2^{3}, 2^{4}, \ldots, 2^{9}\right\}$. A, B, C are subsets of S having equal elements. Given that $A \cap B = B \cap C = C \cap A = \phi$. Find total number of ways A, B, C can chosen if $A \cup B \cup C = S$.

Let set $A = \{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}$ and $ax^{2} + bx + c = 0$ be a quadratic equation where ($a, b, c \in A$) has real roots, then if the probability that one root is greater than other is $P$ then find the value of $43P$.
questions.solution:
For real roots.
$b^{2} \geq 4ac$
(i) $b = 6$ $\quad ac \leq 9$
$a = 1$ $c = 1 \ldots 6$
$a = 2$ $c = 1, 2, 3, 4$
$a = 3$ $c = 1, 2, 3$
$a = 4$ $c = 1, 2$
$a = 5$ $c = 1$
$a = 6$ $c = 1$
17 cases
(II) $b = 5$ $\quad ac \leq \frac{25}{4}$
$a = 1$ $c = 1 \ldots 6$
$a = 2$ $c = 1, 2, 3$
$a = 3$ $c = 1, 2$
$a = 4$ $c = 1$
$a = 5$ $c = 1$
$a = 6$ $c = 1$
14 cases
(III) $b = 4$ $\quad ac \leq 4$
$a = 1$ $c = 1, 2, 3, 4$
$a = 2$ $c = 1, 2$
$a = 3$ $c = 1$
$a = 4$ $c = 1$
8 cases
(IV) $b = 3$ $\quad ac \leq \frac{9}{4}$
$a = 1$ $c = 1, 2$
$a = 2$ $c = 1$
3 cases
(V) $b = 2$ $\quad ac \leq 1$
$ac = 1$ : 1 case
Total cases
$\Rightarrow 17 + 8 + 14 + 3 + 1$
$= 43$
If equal roots $b^{2} = 4ac$
$b = 2$ $ac = 1$ : 1 case
$b = 4$ $ac = 4$ : 3 cases
$b = 6$ $ac = 9$ : 1 case
5 cases
Probability $= 1 - \frac{5}{43}$
$\Rightarrow \frac{38}{43}$
Ans. 38

questions.stem:
Find the number of solutions of the equation:
$5|x + 3| + 7|x - 7| = 5.$

The number of real solutions of equation:
$x|x + 5| + 2|x + 7| - 2 = 0$
questions.solution:
(I) $x \geq -5$
$x^{2} + 5x + 2x + 14 - 2 = 0$
$\Rightarrow x^{2} + 7x + 12 = 0$
$\Rightarrow x = -3, -4$ (Accepted solutions)
(II) $-7 < x < -5$
$x(-x - 5) + 2(x + 7) - 2 = 0$
$\Rightarrow -x^{2} - 5x + 2x + 14 - 2 = 0$
$\Rightarrow x^{2} - 3x + 12 = 0$
$\Rightarrow x^{2} + 3x - 12 = 0 \quad \Rightarrow x = \frac{-3 \pm \sqrt{9 + 48}}{2}$
$x = \frac{-3 \pm \sqrt{57}}{2}$
(Accepted solutions) $\Rightarrow x = \frac{-3 - \sqrt{57}}{2}$
(III) $x \leq -7$
$-x^{2} - 5x - 2x - 14 - 2 = 0$
$\Rightarrow x^{2} + 7x + 16 = 0$
D < 0, hence no real solution
So number of solution = 3
